story.soThat: I can see the complete validation picture at a glance

tasks.task: Implement StatusDashboard class (AC: #1) Create class in rustybt/validation/reporting.py Load all sessions from SessionManager Calculate aggregate validation statistics Generate formatted console output with tables Test: Unit tests for dashboard generation

Implement strategies validated table (AC: #1) Count validated vs total strategies Generate table with Status, Findings, Last Run columns Use ASCII box-drawing characters for table borders Color-code status (green for VALID, yellow for pending) Test: Verify table formatting

Implement layer coverage table (AC: #1) Calculate layer coverage percentage Show status per layer across all strategies Include notes column for DESIGN differences Count layers with findings vs passed Test: Verify coverage calculations

Implement findings summary and confidence (AC: #1) Calculate total findings by classification Count BUG fixed vs open, DESIGN documented Count regression tests created Calculate overall confidence percentage with progress bar Test: Verify confidence calculation formula

Add CLI status command with JSON output (AC: #2) Add status command to CLI main group Implement console formatted output (default) Implement --format json option for CI integration Test: CLI integration tests for both formats
Implement CI exit codes (AC: #3) Exit 0 if all strategies validated, no open bugs Exit 1 if any strategy failed or bugs open Document exit codes in help text Test: Verify exit codes in various states
Write comprehensive tests (AC: #1-3) Test with zero sessions Test with partial validation Test with complete validation Test exit codes in CI mode

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given all validation sessions When status command is invoked Then dashboard displays Strategies Validated table, Layer Coverage table, Findings Summary, and Overall Confidence percentage with visual progress bar
CLI command rustybt-validate status --format json outputs machine-parseable JSON with strategies_validated, layers_covered, bugs_open fields
Exit code 0 if all strategies validated and no open bugs, Exit code 1 if any strategy failed or bugs open for CI integration
